Purpose: Static pre-freeze review of the one-shot data-preparation operator
Environment: Local read-only source/receipt inspection; no target, corpus, helper test or model execution
Expected: Exact helper schemas/counts and CLI; one attempt only; child status preserved; interruption stops/reaps child and seals operator evidence

checks.Actual: test_data.py writes Actual.test_ids/planned/run and integer failures/errors/skipped. Operator checks code zero, Status PASS, exact 28 planned/run, frozen ordered IDs, and all three counts zero. Same direct-script __main__ identity is used on both local and target invocations.

test_freeze_data_spec.py writes Input.tests and Actual.tests_run plus list-valued failures/errors/skipped. Operator matches those exact fields, frozen IDs, count 10 and three empty lists. It does not confuse this schema with the data-helper schema.

checks.Purpose: Fixed CLI, isolation and no retry
checks.Actual: Uses designated data Python -I -B, frozen repo/head/branch and spec SHA, exclusive preparation directory and logs. Runs each helper once and data_prepare once with --spec, --expected-spec-sha and a new data subdirectory. No source substitution, automatic retry or model invocation is present.

Copies data manifest PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED; unknown status becomes BLOCKED; nonzero return with claimed PASS becomes FAIL. Helper failure prevents data execution. A missing receipt or subprocess problem is recorded rather than called PASS. Existing preparation is preserved and returns 2.

Revised operator installs SIGTERM/SIGINT handlers, ignores further termination signals and raises KeyboardInterrupt. Active command catches it, terminates the child's process group, waits and escalates to kill only if needed. Finally records child_reaped and actual returncode. Main catches KeyboardInterrupt as BLOCKED and writes preparation_control.json. No retry was added.

revision_history.finding: No operator SIGTERM handler could bypass cleanup and leave detached child running; final returncode absent on timeout path.
revision_history.resolution: Root added caught signal interruption, ignores repeated signals and records returncode after cleanup; statically re-read revised source.

nonblocking_notes: Root also added an explicit non-assert sys.flags.optimize check before assertion guards; optimized execution is rejected and cannot silently disable those gates.
Independent selected-data auditing is a separate subsequent gate; this operator correctly stops at preparation and does not authorize model execution.
status_scope: Pre-freeze static operator review; no formal acquisition or model result
